flashcard_questions.q: What did the Papal Bull of 1570 do to Elizabeth?
flashcard_questions.a: It excommunicated her and freed Catholics from obeying her.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Italian banker plotted against Elizabeth in 1571?
Which English duke was executed in 1572 for joining the Ridolfi Plot?
What role did Francis Throckmorton play in the 1583 plot?
flashcard_questions.a: He was the go-between for Mary and the Spanish ambassador.

flashcard_questions.q: Which plot of 1586 was the most serious against Elizabeth?
What evidence let Walsingham put Mary on trial?
flashcard_questions.a: Intercepted coded letters showing she approved the assassination plan.

flashcard_questions.q: In which year did Mary, Queen of Scots flee to England?
How long was Mary kept under house arrest in England?
On what date was Mary, Queen of Scots executed?
Where was Mary, Queen of Scots executed?
In which years did Spain send two further armadas?
Which archbishop suppressed organised Puritan opposition?
Who arranged the peaceful succession after Elizabeth’s death?
Which Scottish king succeeded Elizabeth in 1603?
flashcard_questions.a: James VI of Scotland, who became James I of England.

notes: 15 cards: 6 person-to-significance, 5 event/date, 2 figure, 2 cause-effect. Left out the 'how serious was each threat' judgement material, which is essay work rather than flashcard work.
